description: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blue Rescue Team (2006 Chunsoft, Nintendo DS, via RetroArch / melonDS)
long: The Nintendo DS half of the first Pokemon Mystery Dungeon pair, released alongside the Game Boy Advance Red Rescue Team. A personality quiz turns you into a Pokemon, and you and a partner set up a rescue team that answers distress calls from procedurally generated dungeons. Combat is turn-based and grid-based: the whole floor moves only when you do, so every step, item and Pokemon recruited is a deliberate choice. The DS version uses the bottom screen for a live dungeon map and touch shortcuts, and adds Wonder Mail password missions plus wireless friend rescues.
name: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blue Rescue Team
short: Turn-based roguelike in which a personality quiz turns you into a Pokemon: form a rescue team and delve procedurally generated dungeons one shared turn at a time.
